versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation
v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of hugo-blog-tool-free:

- Automates publishing Markdown articles to Hugo blogs, including content analysis, front matter generation, and Git push.
- Extracts title, tags, and categories from content; generates standard YAML Front Matter.
- Automatically adds summary truncation marker (`<!--more-->`) after the intro or first paragraph.
- Handles new tag/category mapping by creating `_index.md` files as needed.
- Supports local preview, standardized file naming, and commit messages for streamlined publishing.
- Designed for personal bloggers—free version focuses on single-article publishing scenarios.
